# Load and prepare data
## Load data
```{r, eval=FALSE}

## Load sample names with filter on q20
vcf_path <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "vcf_data", "all41.bamlist.freebayes.noclump.filtq20.vcf.gz")

## Read data
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::vcf2pooldata(vcf.file=vcf_path, poolsizes = NA, poolnames = NA, min.maf=0.01, min.cov.per.pool=-1)

## SNP infos
head(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info)

## 610 SNPs
wSuz.pooldata@nsnp

## 41 samples
wSuz.pooldata@poolnames

## Matrix for coverage and readcounts with SNPs in rows and samples in columns
head(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage[, 1:20])

head(wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount[, 1:20])

## Check coverage of d. subpuchrella
sort(colSums(wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount[, grep("Ko-Nam_NW|Ko-San_SN6|CN-Kun_KM|D-sub", wSuz.pooldata@poolnames)]))



```

## Select samples
```{r, eval=FALSE}
#samples <- c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006", "CN-Kun_KM5", "IT_Tre_Om300", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1" )
samples <- c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006", "CN-Kun_KM3", "CN-Kun_KM2" , "IT_Tre_Om300", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1")


## Filter individuals
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  pool.index = which(wSuz.pooldata@poolnames%in% samples))

## Export genotypes
geno_data <- round(wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 2)
colnames(geno_data) <- wSuz.pooldata@poolnames

## Add positions
geno_data <- data.frame(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info, geno_data)

head(geno_data, n=50)
## Only one polymorphic SNP in position 1990 of Type II cifB
geno_data[geno_data$Chromosome=="wSuz_1"&geno_data$Position==783699,]

## No polymorphic SNP in Type I cifB (wrong reference genome for wRI?)
geno_data[geno_data$Chromosome=="wSuz_2"&geno_data$Position>=3609 &geno_data$Position<=7131,]
geno_data[geno_data$Chromosome=="wSuz_1"&geno_data$Position>=691 &geno_data$Position<=4213,]
geno_data[geno_data$Chromosome=="wSuz_1"&geno_data$Position>=823038 &geno_data$Position<=826560,]
	
#write.table(x=geno_data, file=here::here("data/derived_data/wol_genotypes.csv"), sep=";", row.names=FALSE, quote = FALSE, col.names = TRUE)
```

## Filter SNPs
```{r}

## 0 individual samples with fewer than 85% of the SNPs covered
ind.callrate <- apply(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 2, function(x) sum(x != 0)/nrow(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage))
sum(ind.callrate<=0.9)

## Filter 0 individual samples with fewer than 90% of the SNPs covered
#wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  pool.index = which(ind.callrate>0.9))

## 36 SNPs with fewer than 90% of individual samples covered
snp.callrate <- apply(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage, 1, function(x) sum(x != 0)/ncol(wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage))
sum(snp.callrate<=0.9)

## Filter 36 SNPs with fewer than 90% of individual samples covered
wSuz.pooldata <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wSuz.pooldata,  snp.index = which(snp.callrate>0.9))
```

# Check MAF across samples
As expected from the presence of a single Wolbachia genotype, the MAF boxplot on the called SNPs shows a reduced genetic diversity (@fig-wSuzmaf). Still, some polymorphism is found at some SNPs in Bal, Trento and Par6, but less in Ren000 and IT_Tre_Om300 (this may also be related to structural variation among these strains ?)
```{r, eval=FALSE}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8 
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of the MAF of called wRI sites on all the samples ."
#| fig-cap-location: bottom
#| label: fig-wSuzmaf

wSuz.maf <- 0.5-abs(0.5-wSuz.pooldata@refallele.readcount/wSuz.pooldata@readcoverage)
colnames(wSuz.maf) <- wSuz.pooldata@poolnames
mean.maf <- rowMeans(wSuz.maf)
pairs(wSuz.maf)
pairs(wSuz.maf[mean.maf<0.05,])
boxplot(wSuz.maf,horizontal=T,las=1,xlab="MAF")

## Add positions
maf_data <- data.frame(wSuz.pooldata@snp.info, wSuz.maf)

maf_data <- maf_data |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
  cols = CN.Kun_KM5:ZB_wRI_Dsim1,
  names_to = c("strain"),
  values_to = "maf"
  )

maf_data |>
 # dplyr::mutate(gene = forcats::fct_relevel(gene, "wsp", after = 1))|>
  dplyr::group_by(strain) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = sum(!is.na(maf)),
    mean_coverage = mean(maf))

p <- maf_data |>
ggplot(aes(x = maf, fill=Chromosome))+
  geom_histogram()+
  facet_wrap(vars(strain))
p

maf_data |>
  dplyr::filter(maf>0.3)
```

# PCA plot 
```{r pca}
#| echo: false
#| fig-height: 16 
#| fig-width: 24 
#| fig-cap: "Random allele PCA of Wolbachia SNPs on all the 8 samples."
#| fig-cap-location: bottom
#| label: fig-wRIpca

## Filter out bad SNPs
#wRI.pooldata.filtered <- poolfstat::pooldata.subset(pooldata=wRI.pooldata,  snp.index = which(meanIso < 0.05))

wSuz.pca=randomallele.pca(wSuz.pooldata, plot.pcs = NULL)

## For the graph
pch.type =rep(16, wSuz.pooldata@npools)
pch.col  = rep(5, wSuz.pooldata@npools)
pch.col[which(grepl("sub",wSuz.pooldata@poolnames) | grepl("CN-Kun",wSuz.pooldata@poolnames))]=8
pch.col[which(grepl("sim",wSuz.pooldata@poolnames))]=7

scree_data <- data.frame(PC = factor(paste0("PC", 1:length(wSuz.pca$perc.var)),levels = paste0("PC", 1:length(wSuz.pca$perc.var))),Variance = wSuz.pca$perc.var)

library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(gridExtra)

# Plot the scree plot
tmp1 <- ggplot(scree_data, aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "steelblue") +  # Bar plot for explained variance
  geom_point(size = 2) +  # Add points to show individual PC values
  geom_line(group = 1, color = "black") +  # Line connecting the points
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Scree Plot", x = "Principal Component", y = "Percentage of Explained Variance") +
  ylim(0, max(wSuz.pca$perc.var))

data=as.data.frame(wSuz.pca$pop.loadings)
colnames(data)=paste0("PC",1:ncol(data))
data$sample=wSuz.pooldata@poolnames
data$strain=paste0("G",pch.col)
data$strain[pch.col==8]="wSpc" ; data$strain[pch.col==7]="wRI" ; data$strain[pch.col==5]="wSuz" 

# Plot using ggplot and ggrepel to avoid overlapping labels
tmp2<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, label = sample, color=strain)) +
  geom_point(size=1) +  # Plot points for each sample
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Add sample names without overlapping
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"), 
       y = paste0("PC2 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[2],2),"%)"), title = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(5,7,8)) 

tmp3<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC3, label = sample, color=strain)) +
  geom_point(size=1) +  # Plot points for each sample
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Add sample names without overlapping
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"), 
       y = paste0("PC3 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[3],2),"%)"), title = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(5,7,8)) 

tmp4<-ggplot(data, aes(x = PC1, y = PC4, label = sample,color=strain)) +
  geom_point(size=1) +  # Plot points for each sample
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = Inf, show.legend = FALSE) +  # Add sample names without overlapping
  theme_minimal() + 
  labs(x = paste0("PC1 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[1],2),"%)"), 
       y = paste0("PC4 (",round(wSuz.pca$perc.var[4],2),"%)"), title = "") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(5,7,8)) 

## Export graphs
(tmp1 | tmp2 ) /
      (tmp3 | tmp4)
ggsave(file.path(here::here(), "plots", "Fig.SX_PCA.pdf"), width = 20, height = 20, units = "cm")

rm(data)
```

# Polymorphism in cif genes
## Extract fasta for Cif A and B
```{r, eval=TRUE}

### Reference
ref_seq <- readDNAStringSet(file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "assembly_China", "wSuz_RW2025a.fasta"))
# Check reference name and length
names(ref_seq)
width(ref_seq)

## Positions
gene.position <- read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "wSuz_genes_BLAST_hits.txt"), sep="\t", header=TRUE)
head(gene.position)
cifAB_data <- gene.position[gene.position$gene_name2 == "cifA"|gene.position$gene_name2 == "cifB", ]

cifAB_seq <- DNAStringSet(
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(cifAB_data)), extract_gene_fasta, gene=cifAB_data, ref=ref_seq))

## Name of the sequences
names(cifAB_seq) <- cifAB_data$gene

writeXStringSet(
  cifAB_seq,
  file.path(
    here::here(),
    "data", "genomic_data",
    "wSuz_typeI&II_cifAB.fasta"
  )
)

```

## Look for polymorphic sites in cif genes
```{r, eval=TRUE}
## Load sample names with filter on q20
vcf_path <- file.path(here::here(), "data", "genomic_data", "vcf_data", "all41.bamlist.freebayes.noclump.filtq20.vcf.gz")
vcf <- vcfR::read.vcfR(vcf_path)

## Select Samples
samples <- c("Col-FR-Bal001", "Col-FR-Ren000", "Col-IT-Tre000", "Iso-FR-Par006", "D-sub", "CN-Kun_KM5" , "IT_Tre_Om300", "US-CA_wRI_Dsim2", "ZB_wRI_Dsim1")
vcf9 <- vcf[, c("FORMAT", samples)]
colnames(vcf9@gt)

## Get reference and alternative alleles
fix <- getFIX(vcf9)
## Dataframe with positions, reference and alternative alleles
vcf_pos <- data.frame(
  row = seq_len(nrow(fix)),
  contig = fix[, "CHROM"],
  pos = as.numeric(fix[, "POS"]),
  ref = fix[, "REF"],
  alt = fix[, "ALT"]
)

## Extract polymorphic position in cifA or B
cifAB_sites <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(seq_len(nrow(cifAB_data)), function(i) {
    
    region <- cifAB_data[i, ]
    vcf_pos[
      vcf_pos$contig == region$contig ,
    ]
    vcf_pos[
      vcf_pos$contig == region$contig &
      vcf_pos$pos >= region$start &
      vcf_pos$pos <= region$end,
    ]
  })
)

## Get name of the gene
cifAB_sites$gene <- sapply(
  cifAB_sites$row,
  function(x) {
    cifAB_data$gene[
      which(
        vcf_pos$contig[x] == cifAB_data$contig &
        vcf_pos$pos[x] >= cifAB_data$start &
        vcf_pos$pos[x] <= cifAB_data$end
      )[1]
    ]
  }
)

## Get the start position of the polymorphic site
cifAB_sites$gene_start <- sapply(
  cifAB_sites$row,
  function(x) {
    cifAB_data$start[
      which(
        vcf_pos$contig[x] == cifAB_data$contig &
        vcf_pos$pos[x] >= cifAB_data$start &
        vcf_pos$pos[x] <= cifAB_data$end
      )[1]
    ]
  }
)

## Only one polymorphic SNP in position 1990 of Type II cifB
head(cifAB_sites)
nrow(cifAB_sites)
table(cifAB_sites$gene)

## Extract genotypes at the selected site
gt <- extract.gt(vcf9, element = "GT")
gt_cifAB <- gt[cifAB_sites$row, , drop = FALSE]



```

# Plot tree
## Alignement
```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(msa)
library(Biostrings)

# Read your FASTA
fasta <- readDNAStringSet("Wolbachia_9samples.fasta")

# Multiple sequence alignment
alignment <- msa(
  fasta,
  method = "ClustalW",
  type = "dna"
)

alignment
## Convert to dan string set
aligned <- as(alignment, "DNAStringSet")

writeXStringSet(
  aligned,
  "Wolbachia_9samples_aligned.fasta"
)

width(aligned)
```

## Clustering of variants
```{r, eval=FALSE}
fstats <- poolfstat::compute.fstats(x=wSuz.pooldata, output.pairwise.div = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, computeF3 = FALSE, computeF4 = FALSE)

## Export divergence
fstats@pairwise.div

## Hirarchical clustering equivalent to UPGMA
tt <- hclust(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div), method= "average")
plot(tt)

## Neighbor joining distance
tt <- ape::nj(as.dist(fstats@pairwise.div))
plot(tt)

#quartz()
## Heatmap
heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div, distfun = as.dist)

## With ComplexHeatmap
div.hm <- ComplexHeatmap::Heatmap(fstats@pairwise.div,
cluster_rows =TRUE,cluster_columns=TRUE,name="Divergence",
show_heatmap_legend=FALSE,column_title = "Divergence (1-Q2)")

div.hm

```
